# DADA HOUSE

> DADA HOUSE is a home services company serving Houston, TX and Jacksonville, NC. Services: plumbing, air conditioning, heating, and home remodeling. Same-day service and 24/7 emergency response with licensed technicians.

Phone: (844) 928-0875
Email: customerservice@dada-house.com

## Services in Houston, TX
- [Plumbing](https://dada-house.com/services/plumbing): Repairs, installations, and emergency plumbing.
- [Air Conditioning](https://dada-house.com/services/air-conditioning): AC repair, maintenance, and installation.
- [Heating](https://dada-house.com/services/heating): Furnace and heating system repair and installation.
- [Remodeling](https://dada-house.com/services/remodeling): Home renovation and remodeling projects.

## Services in Jacksonville, NC
- [Plumbing](https://dada-house.com/services/plumbing/jacksonville-nc): Repairs, installations, and emergency plumbing.
- [Air Conditioning](https://dada-house.com/services/air-conditioning/jacksonville-nc): AC repair, maintenance, and installation.
- [Heating](https://dada-house.com/services/heating/jacksonville-nc): Furnace and heating system repair and installation.
- [Remodeling](https://dada-house.com/services/remodeling/jacksonville-nc): Home renovation and remodeling projects.

## Locations
- [Houston, TX](https://dada-house.com): Primary service area.
- [Jacksonville, NC](https://dada-house.com/locations/north-carolina): Also serving Jacksonville and the Camp Lejeune area.
